title.narrative: Provision of life-saving essential health services to returnees from Sudan in Kirr Adem, Aweil North County, and Majokyinthiou, Aweil East County, NBS

description.narrative: ltpgtMedicair plans to respond and provide essential health care services to returnees from Sudan and host communities in Kirr Adem, Aweil North, and Majokyinthiou, in Aweil East. Widespread conflict in Sudan and most recently towards the States bordering South Sudan has left most communities in dire situations. Medicair targets a combined population of returnees from the Sudan Crisis and host communities of Aweil North (Kirr Adem) and Aweil East (Majokyinthiou). Medicair will support 10,000 individuals through an essential emergency life-saving health service. Medicair’s mobile health units will be deployed to deliver health services to the vulnerable host community, and returnees from Sudan Crisis.ltbrgtIn line with cluster objectives 1,23 as well as allocation strategy, Medicair willltbrgt- Provide OPD consultation for common conditions such as Malaria, Acute Respiratory Infection, and Acute Watery Diarrhealtbrgt- Provide Basic Emergency Obstetrics and Neonatal Care (BEmONC) through ANC, PNC, and Skilled Birth Attendance and Emergency contraceptives.ltbrgt- Provide services to SGBV survivors through Clinical Management of Rape (CMR), training of staff on CMR.ltbrgt- Provision of Mental Health Psychosocial Support services as well as support for disabilityltbrgt- Support referrals of complicated cases.ltbrgt- Support disease outbreak response, surveillance, investigation and ReportingltbrgtThe intervention will target the most vulnerable populations (host community and returnees) in conflict-affected in Aweil North (Kirr Adem) and Aweil East (Majokyinthiou), prioritizing women, children, the elderly, and people with disabilities. Medicair's intervention will prioritize collaboration and integration with other sectors like Nutrition, WASH, Protection/ GBV, and FSL. Strengthening capacities of the Ministry of Health at the state and county levels and ensuring response to health needs in line with South Sudan National Health Policy. Medicair will deploy 2 mobile units, one in Kir Adem in Aweil North and 1 in Majokyinthiou in Aweil East.ltbrgtlt/pgt
